description: Return the documentation section an anchor points at: its text (at most 4 KB) and its first fenced example. Pass an anchor exactly as an error, hint or help entry printed it, e.g. a rate_limited error's `anchor`. Read-only, anonymous, no tenant data. An unknown anchor is anchor_not_found with the nearest anchors in did_you_mean.

anchor.description: A `<path>#<slug>` anchor, e.g. README.md#call-limits, as printed by an error's `anchor` field or a `host.help.search` hit. `<path>#top` and a bare `<path>` (e.g. docs/kinds/chain.md) both return that document's first section.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Optional on the connection that ran signup (or host.redeem): that connection is already bound to the tenant it created, so later calls on it need no tenant_key. On a connection with no Authorization: Bearer header and no prior signup, omitting it implicitly signs that connection up as a brand-new tenant and runs this call as it -- see host.whoami's source field. When both a header and this argument are present, the header wins.

name: host.help.get
